name: Fleischer Scholars Program
org: Arizona State University, W. P. Carey School of Business
what_you_do: Join online sessions with mentors and staff. Earn one elective ASU college credit. Visit the Tempe campus. Learn to think strategically.
who_can_apply: Arizona high school juniors. Picks look at leadership. They look at community service, grades, and family income. They also ask if you are first in your family to go to college.
pay_detail: Free to students who apply and are selected.
duration: Online June 14 to 18, 2027, then a Tempe campus visit on June 21, 2027
deadline_text: The program page lists Feb 15 for priority, March 15 for late, and May 6 as the final deadline for the summer 2027 group. It does not write the year for these dates.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online application. A recommendation is optional. A teacher can write it. So can another person who works in education. It uses an online form.
notes: The page names both a 2026 application and a summer 2027 group. Confirm the year and deadlines with the program at 480-965-5187.
